name: EIC Accelerator
description: The European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator provides grants and equity investments to startups and SMEs developing breakthrough technologies, including quantum computing. It has funded companies such as SemiQon and eleQtron with investments ranging from €2.5 million to €17.5 million, and its 2026 work programme allocates over €1.4 billion for strategic technologies.

sources.title: EIC Chooses Nine Quantum Tech Start-ups in Latest Funding Round
Eight European startups set to receive scale-up funding from EIC under STEP Scale Up scheme — European Innovation Council

news.title: EIC STEP Scale Up Selects Alice & Bob and Quantware Among Eight Deep-Tech Startups for up to €146.5M
news.excerpt: The European Innovation Council selected eight deep-tech startups under its STEP Scale Up scheme on April 27, 2026, including quantum computing companies Alice & Bob (France) and Quantware (Netherlands). Each company is eligible for €10–30M in equity investment pending due diligence, out of 44 original applicants.
